item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 6:25 PM, 15 August 2026(Saturday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Zambales(Palauig, Iba, Masinloc, Santa Cruz, Candelaria), Pampanga(San Fernando, Santo Tomas, Minalin, San Simon, Apalit) and Bulacan(Pulilan, Baliuag, Plaridel, Bustos, Calumpit, Guiguinto, Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Rafael, San Ildefonso, Pandi, Angat) within the next 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in Bataan(Mariveles, Bagac, Limay, Orion), Cavite(Tanza, Rosario, Cavite City, Noveleta, Kawit, Bacoor), Metro Manila(Paranaque, Manila, Quezon City, Caloocan, Malabon, Navotas, Pasay, San Juan, Valenzuela, Las Pinas), Laguna(Siniloan, Santa Maria, Famy), Rizal(Tanay) and Quezon(Real, Infanta) which may persist within 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
